ऋतिक का एक्स-वाइफ सुजैन के लिए प्यार भरा पोस्ट देख फैंस हुए हैरान! 😍

ऋतिक रोशन और सुजैन खान ने 2014 में 14 साल की शादी के बाद तलाक ले लिया था, लेकिन आज भी दोनों अच्छे रिश्तों में हैं। 🤝
हाल ही में ऋतिक ने इंस्टाग्राम पर सुजैन के जन्मदिन पर एक प्यारा नोट लिखा और उनके संघर्षों पर गर्व जताया। 📝
ऋतिक ने कैप्शन में लिखा कि उन्हें इस बात पर गर्व है कि सुजैन ने जीवन में क्या हासिल किया है और किन चुनौतियों का सामना किया है। 💪
ऋतिक ने सुजैन को बेटों Hrehaan और Hridaan की सबसे अच्छी मां बताया और उनकी कंपनी The Charcoal Project की सफलता की कामना की। ✨
इस पोस्ट पर ऋतिक की गर्लफ्रेंड Saba Azad ने भी लाल दिल वाले इमोटिकॉन्स के साथ कमेंट किया। ❤️

क्या आपको लगता है कि तलाक के बाद भी एक्स-पार्टनर्स का ऐसा दोस्त बने रहना सही है? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Hrithik Roshan says he is proud of the challenges ex-wife Sussanne Khan ha faced and overcome, calls her the best mother to sons Hrehaan and Hridaan
ctx.summary: Hrithik Roshan took to Instagram to give a shoutout for Sussanne Khan in a sweet birthday wish.  The two have been divorced since 2014.
ctx.text:
Hrithik Roshan and Sussanne Khan parted ways after fourteen years of marriage in 2014. The two still continue to stay in touch with each other and are often seen in public events. They also continue to support each other via social media comments on special occasions. Hrithik has now penned a heartfelt birthday note for ex-wife Sussanne on his Instagram account, sharing how proud he is of everything she has achieved in life.
Hrithik posted a carousel of pictures with Sussanne, one which also the two of them with their sons Hrehaan and Hridaan. In the caption, he began, “This wish comes belated but from the bottom of my heart nevertheless. Happy, happy Birthday Sussanne.”
He went on to add, “My wish for you is that this year brings you all the love, warmth, joy and magic that you so beautifully and freely give to the people around you. I am so proud of the life you have lived, the challenges you have faced, and the person you have grown into. Truly, Mom's spirit lives on in you.”
Hrithik concluded by calling her the best mother ever to their kids, and wrote, “You are the best mama to Ray and ridz and I am so thankful that they have such a positive source of light in their mother. One that never tires of seeing the brighter side of life ! You are amazing, like Dad says, “Amazing is what amazing does!” You do amazing things. More power to you, may The Charcoal Project find its way into every city across the world that your heart dreams of conquering! I am and will always be here cheering for you.”
Hrithik's girlfriend, Saba Azad, commented on the post with red heart emoticons.
Hrithik and Sussanne tied the knot in 2000 after dating for four years. They share two sons, Hrehaan and Hridaan Roshan. Both Sussanne and Hrithik have moved on in their lives after divorce.
Sussanne is now dating Arslan Goni. In 2022, Hrithik made his relationship with Saba Azad public by sharing a picture with her on social media. Since then, they have been quite vocal about their relationship and often shared pictures from their vacations together.
Hrithik was most recently seen in a cameo appearance in Jailer 2, which starred Rajinikanth in the lead. He was also seen in the action thriller War 2. Helmed by Ayan Mukerji, the film also featured Jr NTR in lead role alongside Kiara Advani. The sixth instalment in YRF spy universe received mixed-to-negative reviews from the critics and earned only ₹ 364.35 crore worldwide at the box office. He will next be making his directorial debut with Krrish 3.
Santanu Das is a Senior Content Producer at Hindustan Times with over 5 years of experience, writing on films, pop culture and film festivals. He has a keen interest in writing about South Asian independent films and has covered several film festivals, including Sundance and CPH: Docx. He also brings a sharp perspective to the monthly column called The Fault in Our Stars, where he writes about a recent film/series and what stops the ‘good’ from becoming ‘great’.

A gold medalist from Banaras Hindu University, Santanu completed his postgraduate studies in English from Jadavpur University. He is also a Rotten Tomatoes-certified film critic. When not watching films or speaking to celebrities, Santanu can be found reading a book. Some of his favourite films are Aparajito, Ponyo and The Double Life of Veronique. His favourite books include The Corrections, The God of Small Things and A Room of One's Own.

Santanu continues to write passionately about films and celebrity culture. He brings a relatable, as well as critically informed, lens to entertainment and culture for a wide audience.
